manualFollowUps: Pages: merging publishes ielts-playbook, ielts-practice, ielts-simulator, sat-practice and sat-simulator. Each entry point now first imports packages/edge-region, which adds ?forceFunctionRegion=ap-southeast-1 to requests for this project's Edge Functions so they run next to the Singapore database instead of at the learner's nearest edge (eu-central-1 for Uzbekistan). Auth, REST and storage calls are unchanged. VITE_SUPABASE_FUNCTION_REGION overrides it; an empty value turns it off. SAT Playbook already does this (#320). No function or database change.
verification: In each app's browser network tab, requests to /functions/v1/ carry forceFunctionRegion=ap-southeast-1 and responses have x-sb-edge-region: ap-southeast-1.

IELTS Playbook public module median first-byte drops from about 1.5 s to about 1.1 s (measured 18 loads each); signed-in Practice and simulator calls improve at least as much since they make more database queries.

rollback.pages: Cloudflare Pages rollback of the five apps, or set VITE_SUPABASE_FUNCTION_REGION to an empty value and redeploy.
